title: Karachi Board Extends Class 9 Exam Form Deadline
excerpt: The Board of Secondary Education Karachi has extended the submission deadline for Class 9 annual examination forms.
body_html:
The Board of Secondary Education Karachi (BSEK) has announced an extension for the submission of annual examination forms for Class 9.

Students and educational institutions now have additional time to complete their paperwork for the upcoming examinations. Further details regarding the updated schedule can be obtained directly through the board's official announcements.
